1. System Architecture & Overview

Bharat CultureMap is engineered as a single-port, production-ready TypeScript web system. It seamlessly merges a high-performance React 19 Single-Page Application (SPA) frontend with an integrated Express 4.21 REST API gateway and a normalized SQLite 3 relational database operating in Write-Ahead Logging (WAL) mode.

Core Pilot Initiative: Built around the Kolhapur Pilot Study ("Voice, Consent, and Credit"), the platform enforces sovereign intellectual property protection for traditional knowledge holders. Prototype reference records are strictly marked as DEMO_REFERENCE, isolating demonstration data from authentic field-verified research.

The architecture mounts the backend API directly into the Vite development middleware on port 3000, ensuring zero-latency local development and unified network binding across local Wi-Fi networks (0.0.0.0:3000).

3. Interactive National Culture Map

The geospatial interface provides an intuitive discovery gateway across India's living cultural traditions. Users can drill down hierarchically from national view down to states, districts (including the verified Kolhapur District pilot layer), talukas, and artisan clusters.

  • Geospatial Filters: Multi-select filtering by category (Craft, Music, Dance, Textile, Food Heritage, Rituals, Games).
  • Provenance Tagging: Clear badge differentiation between Field-Verified and Prototype data.
  • Offline Resilience: Built-in fallback tiles and locally bundled SVG/WebP assets for zero-internet venue demonstrations.
Figure 3.1: Live screenshot of the Interactive National Culture Map showing Kolhapur pilot records and category filters.

4. Living Tradition Directory

A verified cultural catalog categorized under UNESCO Intangible Cultural Heritage (ICH) domains and Geographical Indication (GI) registries. Each entry documents the cultural history, communities of practice, tools, and regional variations.

  • Multilingual Support: Preserves vernacular nomenclature in Devanagari alongside English transliterations.
  • Evidence Grounding: Every tradition links directly to authoritative academic, institutional, or practitioner citations (source_citations table).
  • Media Registry: Curated repository of documentary photographs, oral history audio, and craft process videos.
Figure 4.1: Live screenshot of the Tradition Explorer displaying living heritage categories and UNESCO classification.

5. HerCraft — Women Artisans & Enterprises

HerCraft is a dedicated economic empowerment module supporting women-led Self-Help Groups (SHGs), artisan collectives, and female master craftswomen across India.

  • Collective Profiles: Showcases active artisan count, signature crafts, founded year, and community narrative.
  • Support Needs Matcher: Highlights specific enterprise requirements (working capital, raw material access, design training).
  • Government & CSR Scheme Aggregator: Connects collectives to vetted state grants, subsidies, and capacity-building opportunities.
Figure 5.1: Live screenshot of HerCraft highlighting women-led collectives, enterprise metrics, and funding schemes.

6. Art-Mart — Fair-Trade Artisan Marketplace

An ethical e-commerce engine eliminating predatory middlemen by enabling direct transactions between traditional craftspeople and conscientious buyers.

  • Radical Transparency: Every product lists pricing in INR, material breakdown, making process, and artisan provenance.
  • Direct Commercial Credit: Revenue routes directly to authenticated makers and verified craft clusters.
  • Full E-Commerce State Engine: Client-side shopping cart, simulated checkout with automated order ID generation (ORD-XXXXXXXX), and order tracking.
Figure 6.1: Live screenshot of Art-Mart exhibiting authentic handcrafted items with provenance badges and direct seller attribution.

7. Cultural Calendar & Intelligent Trip Planner

A dynamic seasonal schedule tracking solar, lunar, and regional cultural celebrations, paired with an algorithmic travel itinerary generator.

  • Event Verification: Tracks recurring festivals, entry criteria, visitor etiquette rules, and photography restrictions.
  • Algorithmic Cultural Itinerary Builder: Users select travel dates, starting locations, and cultural interests; the backend computes day-by-day travel routes with artisan workshop visits.
Figure 7.1: Live screenshot of the Cultural Calendar and Trip Planner interface.

8. Ecosystem Hub — Circular Economy & Resources

A cross-sector collaboration portal bridging traditional handicraft clusters with industrial manufacturers and statutory institutions.

  • Industry-to-Art Material Exchange: Industrial manufacturers donate or sell surplus clean materials (leather scraps, brass turnings, organic fabric offcuts) to artisan clusters.
  • Collaboration Request Tracker: Artisans log material requests and monitor allocation and production pipelines.
  • Institutional Resource Directory: Official guidelines from the Development Commissioner of Handicrafts, KVIC, and academic research bodies.
Figure 8.1: Live screenshot of the Ecosystem Hub showing circular economy material exchanges and government resources.

9. Master Practitioners Registry

A curated registry celebrating recognized master artisans, hereditary practitioners, performing artists, and oral knowledge keepers.

  • Practitioner Narratives: Highlights lineage, years of practice, community context, and apprenticeship availability.
  • Privacy-Preserving Contact Protocol: Allows patrons, researchers, and institutions to submit workshop requests without exposing private contact details or home addresses.
Figure 9.1: Live screenshot of the Practitioners Directory highlighting master artisans and inquiry channels.

10. Multi-Persona Authentication & RBAC System

A secure authentication system managing both public user accounts and specialized academic/governance review roles.

  • 5 Public User Personas: VISITOR, BUYER, PRACTITIONER, ARTISAN_SELLER, HERCRAFT_ENTREPRENEUR.
  • 5 Staff Governance Roles: SUPER_ADMIN, FIELD_RESEARCHER, LANGUAGE_REVIEWER, FOLKLORE_REVIEWER, PRACTITIONER_APPROVER.
  • Interactive Demo Switcher: One-click session switcher during development to simulate any role (strictly disabled in production).
Figure 10.1: Live screenshot of the Authentication Portal showing login, multi-persona registration, and demo role switcher.

11. Governance & Admin Console

The nerve center for researchers, linguists, folklore specialists, and administrators to review records, audit consent, and curate platform content.

  • Multi-Tab Control Center: Tabbed management for Cultural Records, User Roles, Locations, Events, Inquiries, Traditions, Sources, and Media Assets.
  • Live Publication Gate Inspection: Inspects real-time consent gate criteria for any record before approval.
  • Media Asset Management: Built-in multi-part image uploader with MIME type verification and thumbnail previews.
Figure 11.1: Live screenshot of the Admin & Governance Console with cultural records curation and live consent gate indicators.

12. The Cultural Rights Passport & Publication Gate Engine

The core intellectual property framework enforcing practitioner sovereignty (HLFA Research Master File Instrument 6.1). A record is strictly blocked from publication (403 CONSENT_GATE_BLOCKED) unless every gate condition is satisfied:

Zero-Tolerance Guardrails: Any record marked isSacredOrRestricted = 1, RESTRICTED, or WITHDRAWN is instantly blocked and stripped from all public discovery endpoints.
Passport Field Conservative Default Supported Values Enforced System Behavior
Identity Display CHOSEN_NAME FULL_NAME, CHOSEN_NAME, COMMUNITY_NAME, ANONYMOUS Masks private legal name in public serializers.
Location Granularity DISTRICT EXACT_WORKSHOP, VILLAGE, CITY_TOWN, TALUKA, DISTRICT, HIDDEN Obfuscates exact GPS coordinates to district/taluka center.
Audio / Video Access PRIVATE PUBLIC, LIMITED, PRIVATE, NOT_PERMITTED Withholds raw oral history audio recordings from public API payloads.
Translation Scope ORIGINAL_ONLY ORIGINAL_ONLY, SELECTED_LANGUAGES, NONE Preserves vernacular linguistic nuance; prevents unvetted AI translation.
AI Use / Training NONE NONE, TRANSCRIPT_DRAFT_ONLY, TRANSLATION_DRAFT_ONLY, APPROVED_RETRIEVAL Strictly blocks automated LLM scraping, model training, and voice cloning.
Download & Reuse PERMISSION_REQUIRED ALLOWED, EDUCATIONAL_ONLY, PERMISSION_REQUIRED, PROHIBITED Disallows automated downloading; requires explicit provenance attribution.
Commercial Use PROHIBITED PROHIBITED, PERMISSION_REQUIRED, BENEFIT_SHARING_AGREEMENT Prevents commercial merchandising without an approved benefit-sharing deed.
Contact Mode MODERATED_ENQUIRY DIRECT, MODERATED_ENQUIRY, UNAVAILABLE Routes communications through admin desk to prevent harassment and spam.
Withdrawal Status ACTIVE ACTIVE, CORRECT_REQUESTED, RESTRICTED, REMOVED Guarantees permanent practitioner revocation right; revoking unpublishes instantly.

13. Relational Database Schema & Data Dictionary

The system employs 19 normalized tables defined across 6 versioned SQL migrations in server/db/migrations/:

Table Name Primary Key Key Fields & References Purpose & Functional Domain
users id (TEXT) email, password_hash, role, account_type, is_active Authentication, RBAC roles, and linked persona profiles.
locations id (TEXT) level, name_en, name_mr, parent_id, center_lat, center_lng Six-tier administrative geography hierarchy (Country to Village).
cultural_records id (TEXT) slug, tradition_id, state_id, district_id, status, is_sacred_or_restricted Living heritage records, private practitioner fields, and dual-language summaries.
rights_passports id (TEXT) cultural_record_id (FK), statements_json, 9 passport fields Instrument 6.1 informed consent and sovereign access controls.
provenance_logs id (TEXT) cultural_record_id (FK), step_type, performed_by_user_id, version_label Immutable audit trail for collection, transcription, translation, and sign-offs.
traditions id (TEXT) slug, tradition_category, unesco_domain, gi_tag_status Living tradition master registry with historical and community context.
tradition_places id (TEXT) tradition_id (FK), location_id (FK), state_id (FK), relationship_role Many-to-many geospatial mapping between traditions and regional practice centers.
source_citations id (TEXT) tradition_id (FK), cultural_record_id (FK), source_title, source_url Bibliographic citations grounding records in official archives and field notes.
media_assets id (TEXT) tradition_id (FK), cultural_record_id (FK), media_type, asset_url Curated repository of documentary photographs, audio recordings, and videos.
art_mart_sellers id (TEXT) slug, storefront_name, craft_cluster_label, owner_user_id (FK) Artisan seller storefront profiles with verification badges.
art_mart_products id (TEXT) slug, seller_id (FK), tradition_id (FK), price_inr, stock_quantity Fair-trade handcrafted product catalog with materials and process notes.
art_mart_orders id (TEXT) order_number, buyer_email, total_inr, items_json, status Simulated customer orders and fulfillment state tracking.
hercraft_enterprises id (TEXT) slug, enterprise_name, women_artisans_count, tradition_id (FK) Women-led artisan collective registry with enterprise metrics.
hercraft_opportunities id (TEXT) title, opportunity_type, organiser_name, benefit_summary Government and CSR grants, subsidies, and training schemes.
industry_materials id (TEXT) title, industry_org_label, material_category, pricing_terms Surplus industrial raw materials available for craft circular economy.
industry_requests id (TEXT) material_id (FK), artisan_email, intended_craft_use, collaboration_status Artisan material applications and allocation tracking.
ecosystem_resources id (TEXT) title, resource_category, organisation_type, official_url Statutory boards, craft guilds, and public sector cultural resources.
cultural_events id (TEXT) title_en, category, start_date, state_id (FK), visitor_access Festivals, gatherings, and seasonal celebrations with etiquette notes.
community_enquiries id (TEXT) enquiry_type, sender_name, sender_contact, message, status Moderated community communications for workshops and maker inquiries.

14. Security Architecture & Production Deployment Blueprint

Security Architecture

  • Field-Level Isolation: Private practitioner columns (practitioner_phone_private, exact_lat_private) are stripped at the repository layer.
  • Signed Session Cookies: HMAC-SHA256 session tokens with HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax, and Secure flags.
  • Rate-Limiting Protection: Sliding window brute-force limiter across login and registration endpoints.

Production Deployment Blueprint

Because Bharat CultureMap relies on a native SQLite relational database (better-sqlite3 in WAL mode) and an active Node.js server process, it cannot be hosted on static file hosts like GitHub Pages. Recommended production environments include:

  • Fly.io / Render / Railway: Mount a persistent volume at /var/data and configure SQLITE_DB_PATH=/var/data/bharat_culturemap.sqlite.
  • Litestream Replication: Enable continuous streaming replication of SQLite transactions to Cloudflare R2 or AWS S3 for zero-loss disaster recovery.
  • Single-Instance Writer: Maintain a single Node.js writer instance attached to the volume rather than multiple replicas sharing a network filesystem.
